query: Crude oil prices rise 12% after OPEC supply cut announcement
event_summary: OPEC+ agreed to cut production by 1.2 million barrels per day, triggering a 12% price surge in WTI crude oil. The price shock propagates through fuel costs, inflation expectations, central bank interest-rate policy, credit margins for banks, mortgage demand in real estate, and broad equity market indices.
